subject: Co-marketing: BluePeak x Redwood — CloudInfra Summit webinar + booth coordination
messages:
From: Aisha Nair <aisha@bluepeak.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom@dataforge.io>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-marketing idea for CloudInfra Summit (webinar + booth)

Hi Vanessa,

Quick intro — I’m Aisha, Partnerships at BluePeak Consulting. We’ll be sponsoring CloudInfra Summit in November and have a small booth slot plus a sponsored webinar track the week before the event. BluePeak runs a bunch of cloud migration and inference modernization programs; we’ve seen customers struggle with inference costs and deployment fragmentation (hosted vs private).

We think a joint webinar (BluePeak + Redwood) focused on "Practical tactics to make LLM inference predictable across cloud, dedicated, and private deployments" would land well with the conference audience. Proposed structure: 30–40 min webinar (product + customer story), then a joint booth demo at the Summit highlighting: routing/fallback policies, autoscaling for dedicated capacity, and an integration checklist for consultancies.

High-level asks from our side:
- Quick confirmation if Redwood is interested in co-hosting (content and 1 speaker)
- A short sponsorship slide deck (we can co-brand) for the Summit organizers
- Suggested speakers and a 2-sentence speaker bio for event listing

We can cover the sponsored webinar slot fee if Redwood helps amplify via your newsletter / social. Attached a short sponsorship summary. Happy to hop on a 30-min sync.

Best,
Aisha Nair
Partnerships, BluePeak Consulting
Attachment: CloudInfra_Summit_SponsorshipDeck.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Nair <aisha@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-marketing idea for CloudInfra Summit (webinar + booth)

Aisha — thanks for reaching out and for the clear plan. Redwood is very interested; the theme maps directly to our product messaging (unified inference, predictable economics).

Quick answers and next steps from our side:
- Yes — we’ll co-host the webinar. I can speak for 15–20 minutes on routing, fallback policies, and the Dedicated vs Private deployment tradeoffs.
- Marissa (cc’d) will own marketing amplification and the co-branded deck. Can Marissa sync with your team on branding guidelines and the Summit sponsor requirements?
- We’ll need a short customer example — do you have a reference customer willing to share a 5–10 minute case in the webinar? If not, we can use an anonymized before/after slide.

Suggested timeline:
1) Wed Oct 8 — 30-min planning call to align content and speaker roles
2) Mon Oct 20 — draft co-branded deck due (Marissa to circulate)
3) Wed Oct 29 — final deck to Summit organizers; marketing push week of Nov 3

I’ve copied Dylan to vet any ops/engineering constraints for a live demo at the booth (KV cache demo / routing fallback).

Available times for a planning call: Oct 8 9:00–11:00 PT or Oct 9 13:00–15:00 PT. Pick one and I’ll send an invite.

Thanks — excited to work together.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Nair <aisha@bluepeak.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Oct 2025 08:51:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-marketing idea for CloudInfra Summit (webinar + booth)

Hi Aisha / Vanessa —

Thanks — looping in initial marketing asks and a draft we can iterate on. I uploaded a co-branded deck draft and a short webinar outline to the shared Drive (link below).

Immediate items for both teams:
- Branding/Logo: BluePeak PNG (transparent) and Redwood PNG (svg) — can you drop to the Drive by EOD Oct 6 (Aisha)?
- Speaker bios: please send 2-sentence bios for each speaker by Oct 6
- Customer story: if BluePeak can provide a contact for a short case, we’ll draft the speaker Qs and release a joint teaser blog
- Demo checklist (for booth): Dylan, can you confirm whether we can show live KV caching demo on a 4xA100 Dedicated node? If not, we’ll do a pre-recorded sequence.

Attachments: co-branded_webinar_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 480KB)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-cloudinfra-campaign
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BP-2025-34

Marissa Cole
Senior Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Nair <aisha@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-marketing idea for CloudInfra Summit (webinar + booth)

Perfect — Oct 8 at 09:30 PT works for me. Inviting 30 min now.

Aisha — can you confirm whether BluePeak will secure the customer speaker or if you’d prefer Redwood to provide the anonymized case? If we provide one, I’ll loop in Solutions to draft a short case study.

Dylan — quick ask for the sync: please prepare two demo options (live on Dedicated 4xA100, pre-recorded run-through) and one slide on system requirements. We want to minimize risk for the booth demo.

I’ll prepare a short speaking outline (topics + time split) ahead of the call and share to the Drive. Thanks all.
